x-e-e4-01.title: Inqaku likaMama nexesha lokudlala likaJisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Thelekisa izicwangciso ezininzi ezikwinqaku likaMama nexesha elicetyiswe ngumhlobo, fumana apho zingahambelani khona, uze uthi hayi ngesiNgesi ngelixa ucebisa ixesha elahlukileyo.
x-e-e4-01.material:
Inqaku uMama alishiye etafileni (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Emva koko umhlobo wakhe uJisu wathumela isicatshulwa. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Thelekisa amaxesha akwinqaku noluhlu lwexesha oluchaziweyo, enye ngenye
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Gweba ukuba 'uluhlu' lwexesha nexesha elinye ziyagqithisana na
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Amagama alula anjengo piano class kunye trash
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imigca yenqaku egqithisana ngexesha nesiphakamiso sika-Jisu (4:15-5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Beka umgca ngamnye ecaleni kwexesha lepaki '4:15-5:15' enye ngenye, uze ubone ukuba iphela phambi kwayo okanye iqala emva kwayo.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwizinto ezithatha ixesha, njengeklasi, sebenza ixesha eziphela ngalo.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Thelekisa ukuba ixesha olifika ngalo ekhaya liphambi okanye emva kwe-4:15.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Sebenza ukuba iklasi iqala nini kwaye iphela nini, uze ulibeke ecaleni kwexesha lepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Ndicinge ukuba ukuhlola ukuba ixesha elinye liwela ngaphakathi koluhlu lwexesha lepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Thelekisa ukuba ixesha lesidlo sasebusuku liphelele emva kokuphela kwexesha lepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Iklasi yepiyano yi-4:00-4:30, ngoko 4:15-4:30 iyagqithisana, kwaye ukukhupha inkunkuma ngo-5:00 kuwela ngaphakathi kwe-4:15-5:15. Ukufika ekhaya ngo-3:30 nesidlo sasebusuku ngo-6:30 zingaphandle kwexesha lepaki.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Phendula u-Jisu ngezivakalisi ezimbini okanye ezintathu zesiNgesi. Fumana izizathu kwinqaku zokuba awukwazi ukuya, uzibhale, uze ucebise elinye ixesha elisebenzayo.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala, uthi hayi kwisivakalisi esinye nge-'Sorry, I can't ...'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala izicwangciso ezimbini ezigqithisanayo ezisuka kwinqaku namaxesha azo, uze ekugqibeleni wenze isiphakamiso sakho nge-'Can we play at ...?'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba unike zombini izizathu, ipiyano nokukhupha inkunkuma?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucebise ixesha elahlukileyo, kwaye ingaba elo xesha aligqithisani nezicwangciso zenqaku?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba likho ibinzana lokwala elinjenge-'I can't'?

x-e-e4-02.title: Gqiba amaxesha okuhamba inja nomsebenzi wasekhaya
x-e-e4-02.goal: Yenza iindibaniselwano ezininzi ezahlukeneyo zexesha lokuhamba nexesha lomsebenzi wasekhaya ezihlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko zenqaku likaDadewethu.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Inqaku uTata alishiyileyo (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Ngezantsi, bhala ixesha ngalinye njenge-'imizuzu emingaphi emva kwe-4:00 p.m.'. Umzekelo, ukuba uqala ngo-4:30, bhala u-30, kwaye ukuba uqala ngo-5:15, bhala u-75.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Yenza impendulo ehlangabezana neemeko ezininzi ngaxeshanye wena
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Yongeza ixesha elithathayo kwixesha lokuqala ukuhlola ixesha lokugqibela
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Amagama alula anjengo walk the dog kunye homework
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Ukuba uMina uqala umsebenzi wasekhaya ngo-5:00 nokuhamba ngo-5:30, yeyiphi imeko kwinqaku ayophulayo?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Yongeza ixesha elithathayo (ngemizuzu) kwixesha lokuqala lomsebenzi ngamnye ukufumana ixesha eliphela ngalo.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zoba uluhlu lwexesha lemisebenzi emibini macala ngamacala emgceni omnye.

x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Beka umsebenzi wasekhaya 5:00-6:00 nokuhamba 5:30-6:00 macala ngamacala kumgca wexesha.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Fumana amaxesha okugqibela emisebenzi emibini ngokongeza ixesha ngalinye elithathayo kwixesha lalo lokuqala.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Le yimeko ephathelele ukuba umsebenzi uthatha ixesha elingakanani, hayi ixesha lokuqala.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Umsebenzi wasekhaya yi-5:00-6:00 kwaye ukuhamba yi-5:30-6:00, ngoko imisebenzi emibini iyagqithisana ukusuka ku-5:30 ukuya ku-6:00. Ukuhamba kuqala emva kwe-5:00 kwaye zombini ziyaphela phambi kwe-6:30, ngoko ezinye iimeko zigcinwe.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izicwangciso ezi-3 ezahlukileyo ezigcina zonke iimeko zenqaku. w kukuqala kokuhamba kwaye k kukuqala komsebenzi wasekhaya (imizuzu emingaphi emva kwe-4:00 p.m.).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ugqibe uluhlu olunokuba lolwe-w yokuqala kokuhamba, emva koko ukhethe ukuqala komsebenzi wasekhaya k ukuze ugweme eli xesha lokuhamba.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ixesha lokugqibela kwisiqalo somsebenzi ngamnye kunye nexesha elithathayo, uze uhlole ukuba imisebenzi emibini iyagqithisana na.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.var.k: Ukuqala komsebenzi wasekhaya (k imizuzu emva kwe-4:00)
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala w no-k njengamanani aphelele (imizuzu) angu-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuhamba okanye umsebenzi wasekhaya uphela emva kwe-6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuhamba kufuneka kuqale phakathi kwemizuzu engama-60 nengama-120 (5:00-6:00), kwaye umsebenzi wasekhaya kufuneka uqale ngaphakathi kwemizuzu engama-90 (ngo-5:30). Phakathi kwazo, ukudibaniswa okungagqithisaniyo yiyo impendulo. Imizekelo: (ukuhamba 60, umsebenzi wasekhaya 0), (ukuhamba 90, umsebenzi wasekhaya 0), (ukuhamba 60, umsebenzi wasekhaya 90).

x-e-e4-10.title: Ukuthumela utitshala umyalezo obhalelwe umhlobo

x-e-e4-10.material:
Umyalezo othunyelwe kumhlobo uJisu (obhalwe ngokubhaliweyo kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

"Hey! I'm sick lol. Can't come 2 school 2morrow. Gimme the homework pls!"

(Ngokunjalo, u-2morrow ufundwa 'tu-morrow', indlela emfutshane yokubhala u-tomorrow.) Ufuna ukuthumela umxholo ofanayo kutitshala wakho nge-imeyile.

x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.a: Isizathu sokugula yimeko ekufuneka uyixelele utitshala nayo. Cinga ukuba ifanele ukutshintshwa okanye igcinwe.

x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.c: Cinga ukuba ukusebenzisa amanani endaweni yamagama kufanelekile na kubhalo olusiwa kutitshala.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.d: Jonga ukuba indlela yokucela ifanelekile kutitshala na.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.explain: U-'lol', '2 school 2morrow' ofinyezwe ngamanani, no-'Gimme ... pls!' yindlela abahlobo abathetha ngayo, ngoko kufuneka zilungiswe kutitshala. Isizathu sokugula ('I'm sick') yimeko ekufuneka igcinwe.
